notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata retrieval is manual rather than automatic on save; preview images are unsupported and fetched favicons are not persisted by the UI.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry has no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-14: The parser supports tag: syntax but treats #tag as ordinary text.
REF-BM-20: Bulk tag removal exists server-side but is not exposed in the selection UI.
REF-BM-24: HTML snapshots serialize the DOM but do not embed external resources, so the saved file is not a self-contained preserved page; PDF targets are handled correctly.
